newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Singapore retains top spot for Australian air cargo.
newsitem.headline: Singapore retains top spot for Australian air cargo.

text.p: Singapore continues to be Australia's biggest export and import air freight market, according to statistics released by the Australian Department of Transport and Regional Development.

A total of 67,946 tonnes of air freight was exported to Singapore's Changi airport hub from airports around Australia in the 12 months ending June last year which is an increase of more than 3,000 tonnes on the previous 12 months, the statistics show.

Hong Kong was in second place with 47,391 tonnes of Australia exports, mostly fresh produce, seafood and perishables compared to 46,779 tonnes in 1994-95. Auckland was in third place accounting for 46,890 tonnes of imports from Australia compared with 43,880 the previous year.

Singapore also took over the top position as an exporter to Australia with 37,028 tonnes compared to 35,965 tonnes the previous year. Auckland slipped to seconsd place at 36,539 tonnes (38,102 tonnes in 94-95) with Hong kong third at 28,472 tonnes (26,337 tonnes in 94-95). . - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017
